constitution.1T: Display is a persistent oriented membrane in which a population of autonomous embodied interlocutors is physically addressed, globally navigable, and continuous through relocation; the repository anatomy itself determines which encounters exist while each holon remains locally itself.

4F.wxy: Relocatable bodies: autonomous embodied holons can be added, moved or differentiated through the population while retaining identity and local tissue.
4F.wxz: Persistent embodiment: the same interlocutor can remain materially itself while orientation and navigation alter its framing or host placement.
4F.wzy: Navigable manifestation: physically admitted holons become visible encounter worlds whose embodiment is reached through the global orientation membrane.
4F.xzy: Stable address ecology: site population may grow, split and remount while continuity and orientation preserve lawful global addressing and encounter identity.

4V.w: Embodiment gives each interlocutor a material local world: shader, background, manifestation and perceptual body.
4V.x: Continuity preserves stable interlocutor identity, local root, state and activity relation across remounting, rebuilds and encounter changes.
4V.y: Population admits actual page-organisms into the global site-space so physically present holons become addressable encounters.
4V.z: Orientation governs global address perception, navigation, camera framing, membrane transition and shared rotational state.

6E.wx: Embodiment remains attributable to the same interlocutor across change because continuity binds material manifestation to stable identity rather than host address.
6E.wy: Population becomes perceptible because admitted page-organisms arrive as embodied holons rather than abstract address records.
6E.wz: Embodied local worlds can rotate, frame and transition coherently because orientation acts on presentation without replacing local manifestation.
6E.xy: The site population can differentiate and be redistributed through recursive addresses without identity collapse because continuity survives relocation.
6E.xz: Navigation and remounting can change where and how an interlocutor is encountered while continuity preserves which whole is moving through that oriented field.
6E.zy: Population becomes globally navigable because orientation resolves physically present holons into address/locus targets and encounter transitions.

changed_scope: Display Orientation owns generic guidance and measured cluster extent; shared Embodiment template carries its existing controls. No site-local tissue or identity branch is introduced.

Pointer/touch rail settling and keyboard hold/release retain their actual different meanings; focused map keys and direct body/cluster selection retain their existing actions. DE/EN guidance remains available through a persistent accessible disclosure.

Font readiness, observed text extents, viewport and legal wrapping resize the existing occupied glass surface. Short carriers have bounded scrollable guidance/control continuation. Closed seam/junction trigger returns to its original center; opening accommodates the measured cluster.

One compact current-context/count header retains the full recursive address in accessible text/title while visual ink may elide. Spatial names, occupied-cell LOD and map-only magnification remain owned by the existing compass.

Display organism3.46 and navigation3.17 retain only the earned local distinction. Root law, INDEX, _cambium, hosted font, geometry, physical population and privacy/content/source ownership remain unchanged.
home.outcome: PASS/BOUNDED_NATIVE_RETURN: one flowing compact header, reserved map and rails, and context-sensitive short guidance with deliberately disclosed complete help replace overlapping fixed text offsets.
